facts: The permissive reference publishes J0/J1 and Y0/Y1 seed approximations in two argument regions separated at magnitude8.

The low-argument J seeds are rational approximations in the squared argument. The constant ratio for J0 is57568490574/57568490411, which differs from one. These constants are fixed published numbers; none may be fitted to captured outputs.
The low-argument Y seeds add logarithmic J terms to rational expressions. The coefficient0.636619772 is a finite approximation to2/pi.
The large-argument seeds combine fixed polynomial amplitude corrections with sine/cosine phases. Published phases are0.785398164 and2.356194491, and the scale coefficient is0.636619772.
Published decimal coefficient tables are available in the cited Tier2 source. No table inferred from measured answers is permitted.

Possible finite-precision hypotheses are ordinary binary64 versus documented x87 arithmetic/assignment stores and the existing cleared private CRT or worksheet elementary operations. Predictions remain hypotheses until exactly compared with recorded answers.
The DLMF three-term recurrence relates higher integer orders to two seeds; it alone identifies no Excel rounding or admission rule.
